name: schedule_rules
description: A recurring local-time window that assigns a playlist to one output of a program. Rules store local values only; zones apply per screen when evaluating.
lifecycle: Replaced as the whole rule set of an output when it is saved, after conflict validation; deleted with the program (cascade inside the module).

columns.Meaning: Backend-generated rule UUID, new on every save.
Company that owns the program (tenant key).
Output the rule programs: screen for a program without a layout, otherwise an area key of its layout.
Display order inside the output, 0 to 199.
Bitmask of the ISO weekdays on which a window starts, bit 0 for Monday, 1 to 127.
True when each window covers the whole local day.

columns.Unit: minute of the local day, 0 to 1,439

columns.Meaning: Local end of the window; earlier than the start ends on the next day, 0 means the following midnight.
columns.Unit: minute of the local day, 0 to 1,439

columns.Meaning: First local date on which a window may start.
Final local date, inclusive; windows clip at the midnight that ends it.
columns.Null meaning: The rule has no final date.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, playlist_id) REFERENCES playlists(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The playlist belongs to the same company and cannot be deleted while used.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, program_id) REFERENCES programs(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE
constraints.Purpose: The program belongs to the same company; rules are deleted with it.
The final date is not before the first date.
Output keys have the area key shape: a lowercase letter, then up to 15 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((all_day AND (start_minute IS NULL) AND (end_minute IS NULL)) OR ((NOT all_day) AND ((start_minute >= 0) AND (start_minute <= 1439)) AND ((end_minute >= 0) AND (end_minute <= 1439)) AND (start_minute <> end_minute))))
constraints.Purpose: All-day rules have no times; other rules have two distinct minutes of the day.
At least one weekday and no unknown bits.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedule_rules_company_id_id_key ON public.schedule_rules USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX schedule_rules_playlist_idx ON public.schedule_rules USING btree (company_id, playlist_id)
constraints.Purpose: Finds rules using a playlist, for the playlist delete check.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX schedule_rules_position_key ON public.schedule_rules USING btree (company_id, program_id, output_key, "position")
constraints.Purpose: One rule per display position of an output.
